set.body:
Problem
`remoteslurm put bundle/ /remote/target/` loses the source trailing slash before invoking rsync. This changes "copy directory contents" into "copy the directory", adding an unexpected bundle/ level under an existing destination.

Verified at 7d3f775d4846440889ba9162f6a4eb6ac0fadae7 on 2026-09-26, using the installed editable CLI.
Source: src/remoteslurm/cli.py:557-565, cmd_put(). It sets src = Path(args.src).expanduser(), then passes str(src) to _rsync(). Path normalization drops the trailing slash.

Reproduction (no remote side effects)
Run with the environment that imports the installed remoteslurm package:

```python
import argparse
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
import remoteslurm.cli as cli

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    source = Path(tmp) / "bundle"
    source.mkdir()
    args = argparse.Namespace(
        src=str(source) + "/", dest="/remote/target/",
        host="fixture", rsync=True, force=False,
    )
    with patch.object(cli, "get_cluster", return_value=MagicMock()), \
         patch.object(cli, "_rsync", return_value=0) as transfer:
        cli.cmd_put(args)
        print(args.src, transfer.call_args.args[1])
        assert transfer.call_args.args[1].endswith("/")
```

Observed: the assertion fails; the forwarded source ends in bundle rather than bundle/.
Live evidence: neuroatlas's Trillium upload produced an extra bundle-01/ directory. All 47 files were verified at the resulting location; no file loss was observed.

Acceptance
- Preserve the caller's trailing-slash intent after expansion and path validation.
- Regression tests cover directory sources with and without a slash, existing and absent destination directories, relative/absolute and tilde paths, and paths containing spaces.
- Assert actual destination layout via a small local rsync integration test when rsync is installed, not only mocked argv.
- Preserve protected-path checks and file-upload behavior; do not enable deletion.

Evidence
/Users/bbuchsbaum/code/neuroatlas/data-raw/surface-transforms-v1/remoteslurm-findings.md
/Users/bbuchsbaum/code/neuroatlas/data-raw/surface-transforms-v1/work/remoteslurm-bug-reproduction.json
/Users/bbuchsbaum/code/neuroatlas/data-raw/surface-transforms-v1/work/trillium-upload.log

Boundary: this confirmed transfer defect does not establish the cause of Trillium's separate scheduler timeouts. No fix has been applied.
set.title: Preserve trailing-slash semantics in rsync-backed put
